messages:
nina: Heads-up: customers can't trace usage to service accounts when requests are proxied/impersonated. Console shows only the caller project.
carlos: Is billing wrong or just the console?
nina: Billing is fine (charged to project A) but dashboards and alerts are grouped by the incoming API key project, so oncall gets pointed at the wrong place.
tara: We could emit an `X-RW-Effective-Principal` header from auth-proxy with the final SA and keep `X-RW-Origin` for the original key. Runtime would attach both to traces.
vik: Agree. Telemetry change: add optional dimension `effective_principal` in metering pipeline. Major risk: SA cardinality could explode metrics.
sre-bot: Note: any new metric dimension must pass cardinality review and preserve billing ETL behavior.
carlos: UX/privacy: don't leak cross-org SA names. Console should link to SA only if viewer has access; otherwise show "principal hidden" with tooltip.
tara: Rollout plan suggestion: (1) start emitting headers behind internal flag for 72h, (2) collect metrics and run cardinality sample, (3) add console column behind feature flag with access gating, (4) let customers opt-in to alerting by effective principal.
vik: For storage we can keep top-K principals per org and bucket the rest into `other_principal`. Also emit `impersonation_depth` as an int metric to spot chains.
nina: Backfill: when we have header data, run a reconciliation job to populate recent traces for better dashboards. Coordinate with billing ETL so reports are unchanged.
carlos: Security: ensure proxies sign the header or have an internal auth check to prevent spoofing.
tara: I'll draft an RFC and UI mocks. Can someone run a 30d sample to estimate unique SA counts?
vik: I'll run the sample and post numbers in the RFC. If counts are too high we'll fallback to rollup strategy.
sre-bot: RFC ticket created: impersonation-metrics-visibility. Add perf estimate and privacy notes.
nina: OK, schedule header flag flip next week with a quick rollback plan for oncall. :thumbsup:
